brief: Fitness center in Pune, 120 sqm single floor. Cardio zone with 6 treadmills, 3 exercise bikes, 2 elliptical. Free-weight zone with dumbbell rack, 2 weight benches, 1 squat rack. Yoga/mat area. Full-height mirror wall. Reception desk near entry. 16 lockers in changing area. Main door plus 3 large east-facing windows. 3.5m ceiling. Rubber flooring.
